sections.heading: Spray Foam Roofing vs. Spray Foam Insulation

runs.v: contractors across the New York and New Jersey area mostly specialize in interior work, spraying foam insulation into attics, walls, and basements, where spray foam insulation can last over 50 years with proper care; a spray foam roof is a different system, with the foam on top of the deck as the roof itself under a UV coating.

c.v: Why is spray foam insulation now a red flag, and why are people removing it?

runs.v: Mostly because of interior foam: foam sprayed on the underside of a roof deck can hide leaks and deck moisture from an inspection, and poorly mixed foam can leave lingering odors, so some home inspectors and buyers flag it. A spray foam roof sits on top of the deck, where leaks show and can be repaired like any other roof.
